ayahs.arabic: تَبَٰرَكَ ٱلَّذِى بِيَدِهِ ٱلْمُلْكُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌ
ayahs.transliteration: Tabāraka-lladhī biyadihi-l-mulku wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr
ayahs.translation: Blessed is He in whose hand is dominion, and He is over all things competent -

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْمَوْتَ وَٱلْحَيَوٰةَ لِيَبْلُوَكُمْ أَيُّكُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًۭا ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْغَفُورُ
ayahs.transliteration: Alladhī khalaqa-l-mawta wal-ḥayāta liyabluwakum ayyukum aḥsanu ʿamalan wahuwa-l-ʿazīzu-l-ghafūr
ayahs.translation: [He] who created death and life to test you [as to] which of you is best in deed - and He is the Exalted in Might, the Forgiving -

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ سَبْعَ سَمَٰوَٰتٍۢ طِبَاقًۭا ۖ مَّا تَرَىٰ فِى خَلْقِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ مِن تَفَٰوُتٍۢ ۖ فَٱرْجِعِ ٱلْبَصَرَ هَلْ تَرَىٰ مِن فُطُورٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Alladhī khalaqa sabʿa samāwātin ṭibāqan mā tarā fī khalqi-r-raḥmāni min tafāwutin farjiʿi-l-baṣara hal tarā min fuṭūr
ayahs.translation: [And] who created seven heavens in layers. You do not see in the creation of the Most Merciful any inconsistency. So return [your] vision [to the sky]; do you see any breaks?

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ ٱرْجِعِ ٱلْبَصَرَ كَرَّتَيْنِ يَنقَلِبْ إِلَيْكَ ٱلْبَصَرُ خَاسِئًۭا وَهُوَ حَسِيرٌۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Thumma-rjiʿi-l-baṣara karratayni yanqalib ilayka-l-baṣaru khāsiʾan wahuwa ḥasīr
ayahs.translation: Then return [your] vision twice again. [Your] vision will return to you humbled while it is fatigued.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنْيَا بِمَصَٰبِيحَ وَجَعَلْنَٰهَا رُجُومًۭا لِّلشَّيَٰطِينِ ۖ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لَهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
ayahs.transliteration: Walaqad zayyannā-s-samāʾa-d-dunyā bimaṣābīḥa wajaʿalnāhā rujūman lish-shayāṭīni waʾaʿtadnā lahum ʿadhāba-s-saʿīr
ayahs.translation: And We have certainly beautified the nearest heaven with stars and have made [from] them what is thrown at the devils and have prepared for them the punishment of the Blaze.

ayahs.arabic: وَلِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِرَبِّهِمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
ayahs.transliteration: Walilladhīna kafarū birabbihim ʿadhābu jahannama wabiʾsa-l-maṣīr
ayahs.translation: And for those who disbelieved in their Lord is the punishment of Hell, and wretched is the destination.

ayahs.arabic: إِذَآ أُلْقُوا۟ فِيهَا سَمِعُوا۟ لَهَا شَهِيقًۭا وَهِىَ تَفُورُ
ayahs.transliteration: Idhā ulqū fīhā samiʿū lahā shahīqan wahiya tafūr
ayahs.translation: When they are thrown into it, they hear from it a [dreadful] inhaling while it boils up.

ayahs.arabic: تَكَادُ تَمَيَّزُ مِنَ ٱلْغَيْظِ ۖ كُلَّمَآ أُلْقِىَ فِيهَا فَوْجٌۭ سَأَلَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَآ أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ نَذِيرٌۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Takādu tamayyazu mina-l-ghayẓi kullamā ulqiya fīhā fawjun saʾalahum khazanatuhā alam yaʾtikum nadhīr
ayahs.translation: It almost bursts with rage. Every time a company is thrown into it, its keepers ask them, "Did there not come to you a warner?"

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوا۟ بَلَىٰ قَدْ جَآءَنَا نَذِيرٌۭ فَكَذَّبْنَا وَقُلْنَا مَا نَزَّلَ ٱللَّهُ مِن شَىْءٍ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ كَبِيرٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Qālū balā qad jāʾanā nadhīrun fakadhdhabnā waqulnā mā nazzala-llāhu min shayʾin in antum illā fī ḍalālin kabīr
ayahs.translation: They will say," Yes, a warner had come to us, but we denied and said, 'Allah has not sent down anything. You are not but in great error.'"

ayahs.arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْ كُنَّا نَسْمَعُ أَوْ نَعْقِلُ مَا كُنَّا فِىٓ أَصْحَٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
ayahs.transliteration: Waqālū law kunnā nasmaʿu aw naʿqilu mā kunnā fī aṣḥābi-s-saʿīr
ayahs.translation: And they will say, "If only we had been listening or reasoning, we would not be among the companions of the Blaze."

ayahs.arabic: فَٱعْتَرَفُوا۟ بِذَنۢبِهِمْ فَسُحْقًۭا لِّأَصْحَٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
ayahs.transliteration: Faʿtarafū bidhanbihim fasuḥqan liʾaṣḥābi-s-saʿīr
ayahs.translation: And they will admit their sin, so [it is] alienation for the companions of the Blaze.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلْغَيْبِ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌۭ وَأَجْرٌۭ كَبِيرٌۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Inna-lladhīna yakhshawna rabbahum bil-ghaybi lahum maghfiratun waʾajrun kabīr
ayahs.translation: Indeed, those who fear their Lord unseen will have forgiveness and great reward.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَسِرُّوا۟ قَوْلَكُمْ أَوِ ٱجْهَرُوا۟ بِهِۦٓ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
ayahs.transliteration: Waʾasirrū qawlakum awi-jharū bihi innahu ʿalīmun bidhāti-ṣ-ṣudūr
ayahs.translation: And conceal your speech or publicize it; indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.

ayahs.arabic: أَلَا يَعْلَمُ مَنْ خَلَقَ وَهُوَ ٱللَّطِيفُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ
ayahs.transliteration: Alā yaʿlamu man khalaqa wahuwa-l-laṭīfu-l-khabīr
ayahs.translation: Does He who created not know, while He is the Subtle, the Acquainted?

ayahs.arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ ذَلُولًۭا فَٱمْشُوا۟ فِى مَنَاكِبِهَا وَكُلُوا۟ مِن رِّزْقِهِۦ ۖ وَإِلَيْهِ ٱلنُّشُورُ
ayahs.transliteration: Huwa-lladhī jaʿala lakumu-l-ʾarḍa dhalūlan famshū fī manākibihā wakulū min rizqihi waʾilayhi-n-nushūr
ayahs.translation: It is He who made the earth tame for you - so walk among its slopes and eat of His provision - and to Him is the resurrection.

ayahs.arabic: ءَأَمِنتُم مَّن فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يَخْسِفَ بِكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ فَإِذَا هِىَ تَمُورُ
ayahs.transliteration: Aamintum man fī-s-samāʾi an yakhsifa bikumu-l-ʾarḍa faʾidhā hiya tamūr
ayahs.translation: Do you feel secure that He who [holds authority] in the heaven would not cause the earth to swallow you and suddenly it would sway?

ayahs.arabic: أَمْ أَمِنتُم مَّن فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يُرْسِلَ عَلَيْكُمْ حَاصِبًۭا ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ كَيْفَ نَذِيرِ
ayahs.transliteration: Am amintum man fī-s-samāʾi an yursila ʿalaykum ḥāṣiban fasataʿlamūna kayfa nadhīr
ayahs.translation: Or do you feel secure that He who [holds authority] in the heaven would not send against you a storm of stones? Then you would know how [severe] was My warning.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ
ayahs.transliteration: Walaqad kadhdhaba-lladhīna min qablihim fakayfa kāna nakīr
ayahs.translation: And already had those before them denied, and how [terrible] was My reproach.

ayahs.arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ إِلَى ٱلطَّيْرِ فَوْقَهُمْ صَٰٓفَّٰتٍۢ وَيَقْبِضْنَ ۚ مَا يُمْسِكُهُنَّ إِلَّا ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍۭ بَصِيرٌ
ayahs.transliteration: Awalam yaraw ilā-ṭ-ṭayri fawqahum ṣāffātin wayaqbiḍna mā yumsikuhunna illā-r-raḥmānu innahu bikulli shayʾin baṣīr
ayahs.translation: Do they not see the birds above them with wings outspread and [sometimes] folded in? None holds them [aloft] except the Most Merciful. Indeed He is, of all things, Seeing.

ayahs.arabic: أَمَّنْ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى هُوَ جُندٌۭ لَّكُمْ يَنصُرُكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ۚ إِنِ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ إِلَّا فِى غُرُورٍ
ayahs.transliteration: Amman hādhā-lladhī huwa jundun lakum yanṣurukum min dūni-r-raḥmāni ini-l-kāfirūna illā fī ghurūr
ayahs.translation: Or who is it that could be an army for you to aid you other than the Most Merciful? The disbelievers are not but in delusion.

ayahs.arabic: أَمَّنْ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى يَرْزُقُكُمْ إِنْ أَمْسَكَ رِزْقَهُۥ ۚ بَل لَّجُّوا۟ فِى عُتُوٍّۢ وَنُفُورٍ
ayahs.transliteration: Amman hādhā-lladhī yarzuqukum in amsaka rizqahu bal lajjū fī ʿutuwwin wanufūr
ayahs.translation: Or who is it that could provide for you if He withheld His provision? But they have persisted in insolence and aversion.

ayahs.arabic: أَفَمَن يَمْشِى مُكِبًّا عَلَىٰ وَجْهِهِۦٓ أَهْدَىٰٓ أَمَّن يَمْشِى سَوِيًّا عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Afaman yamshī mukibban ʿalā wajhihi ahdā amman yamshī sawiyyan ʿalā ṣirāṭin mustaqīm
ayahs.translation: Then is one who walks fallen on his face better guided or one who walks erect on a straight path?

ayahs.arabic: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَكُمْ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْأَبْصَٰرَ وَٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةَ ۖ قَلِيلًۭا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Qul huwa-lladhī anshaʾakum wajaʿala lakumu-s-samʿa wal-ʾabṣāra wal-ʾafʾidata qalīlan mā tashkurūn
ayahs.translation: Say, "It is He who has produced you and made for you hearing and vision and hearts; little are you grateful."

ayahs.arabic: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلَّذِى ذَرَأَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Qul huwa-lladhī dharaʾakum fī-l-ʾarḍi waʾilayhi tuḥsharūn
ayahs.translation: Say, "It is He who has multiplied you throughout the earth, and to Him you will be gathered."

ayahs.arabic: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wayaqūlūna matā hādhā-l-waʿdu in kuntum ṣādiqīn
ayahs.translation: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"

ayahs.arabic: قُلْ إِنَّمَا ٱلْعِلْمُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَإِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Qul innamā-l-ʿilmu ʿinda-llāhi waʾinnamā anā nadhīrun mubīn
ayahs.translation: Say, "The knowledge is only with Allah, and I am only a clear warner."

ayahs.arabic: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ زُلْفَةًۭ سِيٓـَٔتْ وُجُوهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَقِيلَ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَدَّعُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Falammā raʾawhu zulfatan sīʾat wujūhu-lladhīna kafarū waqīla hādhā-lladhī kuntum bihi taddaʿūn
ayahs.translation: But when they see it approaching, the faces of those who disbelieve will be distressed, and it will be said, "This is that for which you used to call."

ayahs.arabic: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَهْلَكَنِىَ ٱللَّهُ وَمَن مَّعِىَ أَوْ رَحِمَنَا فَمَن يُجِيرُ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Qul araʾaytum in ahlakaniya-llāhu waman maʿiya aw raḥimanā faman yujīru-l-kāfirīna min ʿadhābin alīm
ayahs.translation: Say, [O Muhammad], "Have you considered: whether Allah should cause my death and those with me or have mercy upon us, who can protect the disbelievers from a painful punishment?"

ayahs.arabic: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ وَعَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Qul huwa-r-raḥmānu āmannā bihi waʿalayhi tawakkalnā fasataʿlamūna man huwa fī ḍalālin mubīn
ayahs.translation: Say, "He is the Most Merciful; we have believed in Him, and upon Him we have relied. And you will [come to] know who it is that is in clear error."

ayahs.arabic: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَصْبَحَ مَآؤُكُمْ غَوْرًۭا فَمَن يَأْتِيكُم بِمَآءٍۢ مَّعِينٍۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Qul araʾaytum in aṣbaḥa māʾukum ghawran faman yaʾtīkum bimāʾin maʿīn
ayahs.translation: Say, "Have you considered: if your water was to become sunken [into the earth], then who could bring you flowing water?"
